snippet.title: Oortbound Trailer! (Wishlist Link in Description)
snippet.description:
The sun is dying. Dive into the black hole, or warp out. 

Oortbound is a co-op space roguelite for 1 to 4 players: command a fleet, race a collapsing star, fight what's waiting on the other side.

Wishlist Oortbound here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5315770/Oortbound/
